styleLock: Hand-inked Western fantasy adventure comic: expressive variable-weight black brush contours, simplified believable anatomy, bold silhouette design, flat opaque color shapes, two or three hard-edged shadow shapes, sparse dry-brush texture, selective hatching, and a mature handmade print-comic finish; no painterly blending and no glossy 3D.
colorLock: Vivid but disciplined local color with strong warm/cool separation and chromatic shadows; selective jewel-toned teal, cobalt, jade, vermilion, amber, violet, and warm cream according to the scene; no neon, rainbow palette, muddy sepia, global desaturation, or destructive oversaturation.

variants.title: Drowned Causeway
variants.contentBrief: Four adventurers stand ankle-deep on a broken stone causeway across a flooded reed marsh in thin rain; drowned posts, mud, roots, and black water lead to a narrow leaning tower on a low island with one amber window beneath an indigo and vermilion-gold sunset.

variants.title: Cypress Fen
variants.contentBrief: Four adventurers pause on a warped boardwalk through a flooded cypress fen; hanging moss, lily pads, carved boundary stones, and teal mist lead to a cracked tilted observatory with a broken copper dome and turquoise window in amber-violet rain.

variants.title: High Moor
variants.contentBrief: Four adventurers stand on a windswept muddy ridge above a peat bog; standing stones, violet heather, reflective wagon ruts, and an S-curving path lead to a crooked tower on a basalt plug under torn indigo clouds and a fierce amber-vermilion sunset.
variants.headingSpace: calmer dark cloud shelf in the upper-left

variants.title: Drowned Village
variants.contentBrief: Four adventurers stand under a broken chapel arch and look across a flooded ruined village; stepping stones, sunken cottages, wagon wheels, gargoyles, and muddy water lead to a severe square tower on a wooded knoll beneath a jade-teal, amber, and violet sunset.
variants.headingSpace: dark upper-left arch and quieter sky
